name: Q0302-M80 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant Lyman-break galaxy Q0302-M80, seen by Hubble.
label: q0302m80-hubble
story: Hidden in this patch of sky is Q0302-M80, one of a small sample of Lyman-break galaxies whose internal gas motions astronomers mapped from the ground. Hubble's sharp view was meant to show whether galaxies like it are caught in the act of merging.

claims.text: Q0302-M80 is a Lyman-break galaxy in the LSD sample at the pointing position
The LSD project mapped the galaxies' gas with spatially resolved spectroscopy
Hubble imaging was used to test whether the galaxies are undergoing mergers
